name: rag_search
description: Search the indexed knowledge base and return ranked passages with content, score, source and citation locator. Read-only; takes no side effects.

collection.description: Vector collection to search (falls back to the configured default)

fields.description: Extra exact-match metadata constraints merged with the namespace scope

namespace.description: Knowledge-base namespace to search (falls back to the configured default)

query.description: Natural-language question to retrieve passages for

score_threshold.description: Lower bound for hit scores; hits below it are dropped
